properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelTables
properties.description: Returns a ModelTables object that represents a collection of tables inside the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelRelationships
properties.description: Returns a ModelRelationships object that represents the collection of relationships between data model tables. Read-only.

properties.name: DataModelConnection
properties.description: Returns the model WorkbookConnection object from the workbook connections collection that connects to the model.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value representing the name of the Model object. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelMeasures
properties.description: Returns a ModelMeasures object that represents the collection of model measures in the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelFormatGeneral
properties.description: Returns a ModelFormatGeneral object that represents formatting of type general in the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelFormatDate
properties.description: Returns a ModelFormatDate object that represents formatting of type date in the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelFormatDecimalNumber
properties.description: Returns a ModelFormatDecimalNumber object that represents formatting of type decimal number in the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelFormatWholeNumber
properties.description: Returns a ModelFormatWholeNumber object that represents formatting of type whole number in the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelFormatPercentageNumber
properties.description: Returns a ModelFormatPercentageNumber object that represents formatting of type percentage number in the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelFormatScientificNumber
properties.description: Returns a ModelFormatScientificNumber object that represents formatting of type scientific number in the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelFormatCurrency
properties.description: Returns a ModelFormatCurrency object that represents formatting of type currency in the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: ModelFormatBoolean
properties.description: Returns a ModelFormatBoolean object that represents formatting of type True/False in the data model. Read-only.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Refreshes all data sources associated with the model, fully reprocesses the model, and updates all Excel data features associated with the model.

methods.name: AddConnection
methods.description: Adds a new WorkbookConnection to the model with the same properties as the one supplied as an argument.

methods.name: CreateModelWorkbookConnection
methods.description: Returns a WorkbookConnection object of type ModelConnection.

parameters.name: ModelTable
parameters.description: Either a model table name or a model table object.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Workbook's data model. This is called by default the first time the model is used.
